annotations.title: Bid for Featured, paid in USDC

description: Bid on the Featured spot in USDC over x402 — the same auction as a card bid (minimum $51 right now), but settled on-chain with no checkout and no human in the loop. Call without payment_signature for the 402 quote, sign accepts[0] as an EIP-3009 authorization, call again with payment_signature echoing it as `accepted`. The product must already be listed. Omit amount_usd to bid $51.

amount_usd.description: Bid in USD. Omit to bid the minimum (51).

payment_signature.description: The PAYMENT-SIGNATURE header value: base64 JSON x402 v2 PaymentPayload — accepts[0] from the quote, signed and echoed back as `accepted`. Omit to get the quote back as a 402.

url.description: URL of a listing that is already on the directory.
